41509-the-mystery-of-the-lost-dauphin-lo.title: (Louis XVII)
41509-the-mystery-of-the-lost-dauphin-lo.creator: Unknown
41509-the-mystery-of-the-lost-dauphin-lo.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It has been claimed that she bears to Spain such a relation as Turgénieff to Russia and Zola to France. She herself says somewhere that she is skeptical regarding the existence of Realistic, Idealistic and Romantic writers, averring, in her trenchant style, that authors constitute but two classes, _good_ and _poor_.

72957-the-aristocrats.title: [Illustration]
72957-the-aristocrats.creator: Gertrude Atherton
72957-the-aristocrats.description: A book by Gertrude Atherton. and hemlocks and birches had great-grandfathers about the same time--the sensation is almost uncanny, and I realise how over-civilised we all are. Not that I am blasée at twenty-six. God forbid; and I never have been so keen about anything in my life as I am to see every rapidly succeeding phase of this extraordinary country.

arxiv-1407-1753.title: Minimising biases in Full Configuration Interaction Quantum Monte Carlo
arxiv-1407-1753.creator: W. A. Vigor, J. S. Spencer, M. J. Bearpark, A. J. W. Thom
arxiv-1407-1753.description: Abstract We show that Full Configuration Interaction Quantum Monte Carlo (FCIQMC) is a Markov Chain in its present form. We construct the Markov matrix of FCIQMC for a two determinant system and hence compute the stationary distribution. These solutions are used to quantify the dependence of the population dynamics on the parameters defining the Markov chain.

arxiv-2101-12494.title: Analog dual to a 2+1-dimensional holographic superconductor
arxiv-2101-12494.creator: Neven Bilić, Júlio C. Fabris
arxiv-2101-12494.description: Abstract We study an analog hydrodynamic model that mimics a 3+1 AdS planar BH spacetime dual to a 2+1-dimensional superconductor. We demonstrate that the AdS 4 bulk and its holographic dual could be realized in nature in an analog gravity model based on fluid dynamics.

arxiv-2107-07191.title: Deep Learning based Food Instance Segmentation using Synthetic Data
arxiv-2107-07191.creator: Deokhwan Park, Joosoon Lee, Junseok Lee, Kyoobin Lee
arxiv-2107-07191.description: Abstract In the process of intelligently segmenting foods in images using deep neural networks for diet management, data collection and labeling for network training are very important but labor-intensive tasks. In order to solve the difficulties of data collection and annotations, this paper proposes a food segmentation method applicable to real-world through synthetic data.

arxiv-2303-14517.title: Indonesian Text-to-Image Synthesis with Sentence-BERT and FastGAN
arxiv-2303-14517.creator: Made Raharja Surya Mahadi 1 and Nugraha Priya Utama 1
arxiv-2303-14517.description: Abstract Currently, text-to-image synthesis uses text encoder and image generator architecture. Research on this topic is challenging. This is because of the domain gap between natural language and vision. Nowadays, most research on this topic only focuses on producing a photo-realistic image, but the other domain, in this case, is the language, which is less concentrated.

arxiv-2406-04837.title: Normal and superconducting properties of La 3 Ni 2 O 7
arxiv-2406-04837.creator: Meng Wang, Hai-Hu Wen, Tao Wu, Dao-Xin Yao, Tao Xiang
arxiv-2406-04837.description: Abstract This review provides a comprehensive overview of current research on the structural, electronic, and magnetic characteristics of the recently discovered high-temperature superconductor La 3 Ni 2 O 7 under high pressures. We present the experimental results for synthesizing and characterizing this material, derived from measurements of transport, thermodynamics, and various spectroscopic techniques, and discuss their physical implications.

arxiv-2504-03664.title: PIPO: Pipelined Offloading for Efficient Inference on Consumer Devices
arxiv-2504-03664.creator: Yangyijian Liu, Jun Li, Wu-Jun Li
arxiv-2504-03664.description: Abstract The high memory and computation demand of large language models (LLMs) makes them challenging to be deployed on consumer devices due to limited GPU memory. Offloading can mitigate the memory constraint but often suffers from low GPU utilization, leading to low inference efficiency.

arxiv-2508-06111.title: SKATE, a Scalable Tournament Eval: Weaker LLMs differentiate between stronger ones using verifiable challenges
arxiv-2508-06111.creator: Dewi S. W. Gould, Bruno Mlodozeniec, Samuel F. Brown
arxiv-2508-06111.description: Abstract Evaluating the capabilities and risks of foundation models is paramount, yet current methods demand extensive domain expertise, hindering their scalability as these models rapidly evolve. We introduce SKATE: a novel evaluation framework in which large language models (LLMs) compete by generating and solving verifiable tasks for one another.

pmc-10689856.title: Cervical Myelopathy Due to Epidural Hematoma at the Cervicomedullary Junction Associated With Ventriculoperitoneal Shunt Overdrainage: A Case Report
pmc-10689856.creator: Ji Woong Park, Junwon Park
pmc-10689856.description: We present a case of cervical myelopathy caused by epidural hematoma formation due to chronic cerebrospinal fluid overdrainage. A 55-year-old man who underwent ventriculoperitoneal (V-P) shunt surgery for normal pressure hydrocephalus presented with progressive weakness of both the upper and lower extremities.

pmc-11422290.title: Key components of rehabilitation programmes for adults with complex fractures following traumatic injury: A scoping review
pmc-11422290.creator: Lucy Silvester, Anna Higo, Rebecca S Kearney, David McWilliams, Shea Palmer
pmc-11422290.description: Highlights•Lack of rehabilitation is a huge issue for people with complex fractures following traumatic injury.•This scoping review found significant heterogeneity in the literature with multiple different intervention components.•Reporting of interventions is poor despite validated tools such as the TIDieR framework being available to researchers.•Development of future interventions needs to involve key stakeholders, principally the patient voice.

pmc-11660944.title: Software codesign between end users and developers to enhance utility for biodiversity conservation
pmc-11660944.creator: Mary E Blair, Elkin A Noguera-Urbano, Jose Manuel Ochoa-Quintero, Andrea Paz, Cristina Lopez-Gallego, María Ángela Echeverry-Galvis, Juan Zuloaga, Pilar Rodríguez, Leonardo Lemus-Mejia, Peter Ersts, Daniel F López-Lozano, Matthew E Aiello-Lammens, Hector M Arango, Leonardo Buitrago, Samuel Chang Tri
pmc-11660944.description: Creating software tools that address the needs of a wide range of decision-makers requires the inclusion of differing perspectives throughout the development process. Software tools for biodiversity conservation often fall short in this regard, partly because broad decision-maker needs may exceed the toolkits of single research groups or even institutions.

pmc-12588988.title: Microwave ablation triggers OX40L-mediated disruption of TNFRSF4+ Treg immunosuppressive activity
pmc-12588988.creator: Runqi Guo, Yufeng Wang, Jie Sun, Yuanming Li, Zhixin Bie, Xiaoguang Li
pmc-12588988.description: ObjectiveRegulatory T cells (Tregs) play a pivotal role in tumor immune evasion, and strategies to overcome their immunosuppressive activity are urgently needed. This study investigates the immunomodulatory effects of microwave ablation (MWA) on TNFRSF4+ Tregs, focusing on the OX40L/TNFRSF4 signaling axis as a potential therapeutic target.MethodsTNFRSF4+ Tregs were isolated from C57BL/6 mice and subjected to MWA-mimetic thermal stress.

pmc-13053076.title: Cognitive dysfunction and multiple sclerosis
pmc-13053076.creator: David E. Freedman, Anthony Feinstein
pmc-13053076.description: rticularly thalamic atrophy, is a key radiologic correlate of cognitive dysfunction in MS.1 Additional risk factors contribute to MS-related cognitive dysfunction Ancillary contributors to cognitive dysfunction include depression, sleep disturbances, vascular comorbidities, cannabis tetrahydrocannabinol use, and anticholinergic medications.2,3 Personalized discussions can guide how to mitigate risk.

pmc-13124709.title: Building novel LLM-enabled explainable ensemble transformer models combining endoscopic and CT images for discriminating the different grades of gastrointestinal cancers
pmc-13124709.creator: Ali Algarni, Ahood A. Al-Eidan, Surbhi B. Khan, Marwah A. Halwani, Ahlam Almusharraf, Yongwon Cho, Yunyoung Nam
pmc-13124709.description: Gastrointestinal cancer (GC) is particularly malignant as they tend to progress slowly before advanced stages due to the forecast of early-specific symptoms. The heterogeneous properties of GCs require extremely precise and sensitive diagnostic techniques that can integrate in-depth structural information and surface-level data to distinguish cancer severity grades, thereby significantly lowering mortality rates.

pmc-13181555.title: Comparison of physical examination, laboratory and radiologic findings in the diagnosis of acute appendicitis
pmc-13181555.creator: Ozgur Ekinci, Furkan Kilic, Muhammet Ali Aydemir, Ihsan Metin Leblebici, Cem Ilgın Erol, Ayse Nur Toksoz Yildirim, Tunc Eren, Hasan Guclu, Orhan Alimoglu
pmc-13181555.description: OBJECTIVEThe aim of the present study was to compare the diagnostic performance of physical examination, routinely used laboratory markers, and radiological imaging modalities in adult patients with suspected acute appendicitis (AA), and to evaluate the relative contribution of each diagnostic tool under real-world clinical conditions.METHODSThis prospective observational study included 665 consecutive adult patients who underwent appendectomy for AA.

pmc-13238363.title: Antibiotics in the first week of life are not associated with functional gastrointestinal disorders at 9–12 years of age
pmc-13238363.creator: Nora C. Carpay, Kim Kamphorst, Ruurd M. van Elburg, Arine M. Vlieger
pmc-13238363.description: ObjectivesDysbiosis due to early‐life antibiotics may contribute to the development of functional gastrointestinal disorders (FGIDs). This follow‐up study of a birth cohort primarily investigates the association between antibiotic treatment in the first week of life and the presence of FGIDs at 9–12 years. Secondarily, it examines whether a history of infantile colic or current food allergy is associated with FGIDs.
